# Zmq RPC commands

<!-- This file is generated by `contrib/devtools/gen-rpc-docs.py`. Do not edit it manually. -->

The `Zmq` category of the DeFiChain JSON-RPC interface exposes 1 command. The text below is the help output of the node itself, so it matches the binary that generated this page.

For the complete interface, see the [RPC and CLI reference](../index.md).

## getzmqnotifications

```text
getzmqnotifications

Returns information about the active ZeroMQ notifications.

Result:
[
  {                        (json object)
    "type": "pubhashtx",   (string) Type of notification
    "address": "...",      (string) Address of the publisher
    "hwm": n                 (numeric) Outbound message high water mark
  },
  ...
]

Examples:
> defi-cli getzmqnotifications 
> curl --user myusername --data-binary '{"jsonrpc": "1.0", "id":"curltest", "method": "getzmqnotifications", "params": [] }' -H 'content-type: text/plain;' http://127.0.0.1:8554/
```
